scope: Only current role ACL/backfill/page authorization and owner mirror/queue isolation; no safe commit watermark/epoch claim (RP13-T03 later), no business migrations or role binding feature.

T-RP-04-RP08.rule: Repeatable-read current-auth DB snapshot ACL sha256 binds actor/systemRole/securityVersion, sorted permissions, project membership role/joinedAt/manager and projectionVersion. Missing/stale client aclVersion forces current-scope full snapshot; signed pagination fingerprint rejects after ACL change. Client invalidates old authorization before changed-snapshot writes, atomically publishes mirror+ACL+cursor at final page; partial snapshot cannot authorize fallback. Five minute offline authorization lease. Safe watermark/epoch provided later by RP13, not proven here.

T-RP-12-RP08.rule: Preserve original queue/conflict/dead copies. Check current fresh write project/entity/action/capability before any reserve/query/push. Denied items retain scopeBlocked marker; original payload/key/binding untouched. Returning grant never auto-sends a previously isolated item; explicit same-binding recheck required. No projection leaks or guessed owner assignment.
